info.title: API.SH: JB Hi-Fi
info.description: The JB Hi-Fi API from API.SH: public JB Hi-Fi data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One JB Hi-Fi product: everything in search plus Shopify product and variant ids, barcode, price excluding GST, description, every specification, track list, actors and directors (music and movies), variants with prices and availability, images and the original record in `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jbhifi-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A SKU such as 840510 (the `id` in search results), or a jbhifi.com.au/products/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Questions and answers about one JB Hi-Fi product: the question, details, nickname, date, source when syndicated, and every answer with its author, date, brand flag and helpful votes. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jbhifi-questions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A SKU or jbhifi.com.au product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest or most_answered.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Questions per page, 1-100 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
JB Hi-Fi (Australia) product search with every filter the shop offers: SKU, link, name, brand, model, price, was price and saving, cashback price, rating, sale and marketplace flags, seller, stock status for delivery, click & collect and in store, preorder, delivery tag, tags (Clearance, Online Only...), category path, release date and image. `facets` lists every filter for the query with counts: brands, sellers, categories, tags, stock status and every specification (use `filter` with those). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Without `q`, give a category, brand, collection, tag or seller to browse.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jbhifi-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords (optional when browsing a category, brand, collection, tag or seller).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category name from the category facet (e.g. Laptops, Windows laptops).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brands, several separated by `|` (e.g. HP|DELL).

parameters.name: sold_by
parameters.description: Sellers, several separated by `|` (e.g. JB Hi-Fi).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in AUD.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in AUD.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Minimum rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: true for products on promotion.

parameters.name: exclude_marketplace
parameters.description: true to leave marketplace sellers out.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Stock status: InStock, LimitedStock, AwaitingStock, PreOrder, NotAvailable, NoLongerAvailable (several separated by `|`).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tags from the tag facet (e.g. Clearance, Online Only).

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A collection handle from the collection facet.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any specification as Name:value pairs from `facets`, separated by `;` (e.g. RAM (GB):16).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest, oldest, name_asc, name_desc, rating.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-100 (default 36).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 14ITN9 14" HD Laptop (Intel N150)[128GB/4GB]

get.description:
JB Hi-Fi and JB Hi-Fi HOME stores with id, name, type, address, coordinates, phone, click & collect / delivery / cash & carry flags, regular opening hours and this week's hours (with holiday changes). Filter by state, postcode or name, or sort by distance from a point.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jbhifi-stores

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A store name, suburb or 4-digit postcode.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT or NT.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Store or Home.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude to sort by distance (with lng).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude (with lat).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores to return, 1-300 (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

stores.address: Shop R16, Terminal 1 (Qantas), Qantas Domestic Airport, Departure Dr

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
